# bluestonepim_dictionary_attribute_definition (Resource)

Attribute definition of the `dictionary` data type. Manage the values with `bluestonepim_dictionary_attribute_value`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bluestonepim_dictionary_attribute_definition" "country" {
  name                  = "Country"
  number                = "country"
  selected_values_limit = 1
}

resource "bluestonepim_dictionary_attribute_definition" "city" {
  name                 = "City"
  number               = "city"
  parent_definition_id = bluestonepim_dictionary_attribute_definition.country.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the attribute definition.

### Optional

- `context_aware` (Boolean) Whether the attribute can have a different value per context (language or channel). When `false` the attribute is global: it has one value, shared by all contexts. Uses the Bluestone default when not set. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `description` (String) The description of the attribute definition.
- `external_source` (Boolean) Whether the attribute is an external source.
- `group_id` (String) The ID of the attribute group (see `bluestonepim_attribute_group`).
- `internal` (Boolean) Whether the attribute is internal.
- `number` (String) The number of the attribute definition.
- `parent_definition_id` (String) The ID of the parent dictionary definition. Used to filter the values of this dictionary based on the value selected in the parent dictionary.
- `selected_values_limit` (Number) The maximum number of values that can be selected.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Platform-generated unique identifier of the attribute definition.
